title: Peli Motto
subtitle: Independent
description: Peli Motto ran Hangar 3-5 in the rough and tumble city of Mos Eisley. Motto made a living refueling and repairing battered starships. Peli met The Mandalorian Din Djarin when he required assistance with his Razor Crest. Since then, she had taken quite a shine to the young Grogu and became one of Mando's closed friends and trusted allies.
